sentences.text: The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Rashmi S.U.Powar.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 24-04- 2019.

After the marriage, accused No.1 and 2 with a common intention had subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty by demanding her to pay the EMI's to the site and car which the accused wanted to purchase.

Further on 20-07-2022 at about 9-30 P.M the accused had quarreled with CW1 and on the same issue had assaulted CW1 with a computer mouse on the left side of her head causing bleeding injuries and on 21-07-2022 at about 10.15 P.M the accused No.1 quarreled with CW1 and assaulted her with wooden chapathi roller on her head and nose causing bleeding  3  C.C.No.33993/2022 injuries to her and both the accused had threatened to kill her, if she gives complaint to the police.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.213/2022 came to be registered against the accused No.1 and 2for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of Girinagar P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused person caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry,

sentences.text: 9 . POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked  5  C.C.No.33993/2022 Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Rashmi.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 24-04-2019 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.

11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is Girinagar Police Station vs Deepak Sadavar on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169089823/
4 apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.

entities.text: Girinagar Police Station vs Deepak Sadavar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, this court  6  C.C.No.33993/2022 was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER In exercise of power conferred Under are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 324, 506 R/w Sec. 34 of IPC.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 and 2 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
